note: Licence terms of third-party data are recorded here and are not changed by the repository licence (NOTICE.md section 2). Round 2 (2026-11-24): MovieLens 1M adopted for calibration only (owner-approved); its files are git-ignored and never committed.

synthetic.status: implemented (src/trust/simulate.py); base parameters calibrated on MovieLens 1M (research/protocol.md section 13)
synthetic.description: Simulated catalogues: latent quality, rounded and clipped noisy star ratings, negative binomial review counts, optional under-reporting selection and quality-dependent exposure. Specified in research/protocol.md section 2.
synthetic.seed_scheme: numpy SeedSequence([20261124, exp_number, seed_index]) with child streams
synthetic.note_sha256: no stored dataset: catalogues are regenerated from configs and seeds; result files carry their own SHA-256

real.name: MovieLens 1M (GroupLens Research, University of Minnesota)
real.status: adopted 2026-11-24 for calibration only (owner approval, round 2); not committed
real.role: Calibrates the NegBin review-count dispersion and the latent quality Beta(a, b) of the simulation (research/protocol.md section 13.1). No second test; the misranking test stays simulated.
real.licence_summary: README 'USAGE LICENSE' (opened 2026-11-24): 'may be used for any research purposes' under conditions: no stated or implied endorsement by the University of Minnesota or GroupLens; acknowledge use in publications and cite Harper and Konstan 2015 (doi:10.1145/2827872); 'may not redistribute the data without separate permission'; no commercial or revenue-bearing use without permission from a GroupLens faculty member. Matches the approval ('research use, no redistribution').
real.citation: F. Maxwell Harper and Joseph A. Konstan. 2015. The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4), Article 19. doi:10.1145/2827872
real.personal_data: ratings.dat carries pseudonymous numeric user ids only; users.dat (gender, age, occupation, zip code) is not extracted or read. The processed form is per-movie star counts with no user information. No row-level data is committed.
real.ingestion: src/trust/ingest.py (pure; schema validation and exclusion counts); fixture tests/fixtures/movielens/ (synthetic rows only)
real.derived_committed: data/calibration/movielens-1m-fit.json (fitted parameters and aggregate counts only)
